title: About
description: EchoPhase is an open-source platform for managing bots and connecting services.
heading: Bots and services, connected in one place
lead: EchoPhase is an open-source platform for managing bots and connecting services: link your accounts, automate tasks with workflows and reach everything through one API.

connections.title: Connections
connections.text: Link Discord and Twitch accounts once; EchoPhase keeps their tokens fresh and encrypted, and your bots use them.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.text: Automate tasks from blocks that run on a schedule or on events, with storage that persists between runs.

api.title: API and API clients
api.text: Everything the web app does is in the API. Give each bot or script its own client with only the permissions it needs.

realtime.title: Realtime gateway
realtime.text: One WebSocket for events from your connections and workflows, as they happen.

open.title: Open source
open.text: Server, web app and chart are public under the BSD 3-Clause License.

self_hosted.title: Yours to run
self_hosted.text: Run your own instance with the Helm chart or Docker Compose.

private.title: Private by default
private.text: No ads or third-party trackers; statistics and error reports are self-hosted and only with your permission.
